Class VisionCameraConfig

java.lang.Object
yall.VisionCameraConfig
public class VisionCameraConfig extends Object
Settings shared by every VisionCamera, whatever the vendor. 
VisionCameraConfig config = new VisionCameraConfig()
    .withRobotToCamera(Inches.of(12), Inches.of(0), Inches.of(10),
                       Degrees.of(0), Degrees.of(-15), Degrees.of(0))
    .withPoseEstimationMode(PoseEstimationMode.HEADING_ASSISTED)
    .withPoseFilter(new VisionPoseFilter().withMaxAmbiguity(0.15));

Vendor settings that YALL doesn't cover go through withVendorConfig(Object), or straight to the vendor object from VisionCamera.getCamera().

    • withRobotToCamera

      public VisionCameraConfig withRobotToCamera(Transform3d robotToCamera)
      Sets where the camera is on the robot. Pose estimates, simulation and Synapse's robot pose all need it. On a Limelight it overrides the camera pose set in the web interface.
      Parameters:
      robotToCamera - Transform from the robot origin to the camera lens.
      Returns:
      This config, for chaining.

    • withRobotToCamera

      public VisionCameraConfig withRobotToCamera(Distance forward, Distance left, Distance up, Angle roll, Angle pitch, Angle yaw)
      Sets where the camera is on the robot, measured from the robot's center on the floor. The arguments follow the order of Limelight's own camera pose: forward, left, up, then roll, pitch, yaw. 
      config.withRobotToCamera(
    Inches.of(12), Inches.of(0), Inches.of(10), // 12" forward, centered, 10" up
    Degrees.of(0), Degrees.of(-15), Degrees.of(0)); // tilted 15° up
      Parameters:
      forward - Distance forward of the robot center. Negative is behind it.
      left - Distance left of the robot center. Negative is right of it.
      up - Height above the floor.
      roll - Rotation about the camera's forward axis, counterclockwise positive.
      pitch - Rotation about the left axis. Negative tilts the camera up.
      yaw - Rotation about the up axis, counterclockwise positive. 180° faces backward.
      Returns:
      This config, for chaining.
      See Also:
      • withRobotToCamera(Transform3d)

    • withCameraProperties

      public VisionCameraConfig withCameraProperties(org.photonvision.simulation.SimCameraProperties properties)
      Sets the camera's resolution, field of view, frame rate, latency and noise. Simulation uses them, and Synapse uses them to turn pixel positions into angles. Each vendor wrapper has a default; withCameraModel(CameraModel) sets them from a camera's published specs.
      Parameters:
      properties - PhotonVision camera properties.
      Returns:
      This config, for chaining.

    • withCameraModel

      Returns:

    • withSimulatedVideoStreams

      public VisionCameraConfig withSimulatedVideoStreams(boolean enabled)
      Sets whether the simulated camera streams what it would see: PhotonVision draws the AprilTags (and, with withSimulatedWireframe(boolean), the field) from the camera's point of view. The streams cost CPU, so they default to off.

      The streams are served by WPILib's CameraServer as YALL-<camera name>-raw and YALL-<camera name>-processed (<camera name>-raw and -processed for a PhotonVision camera). Open them in a dashboard's camera stream widget, or in a browser at http://localhost:1181, 1182 and up, one port per stream in the order they were made.

      Parameters:
      enabled - true to stream raw and processed simulated video.
      Returns:
      This config, for chaining.

    • withSimulatedWireframe

      public VisionCameraConfig withSimulatedWireframe(boolean enabled)
      Sets whether the simulated video streams also draw the field's floor and walls, which helps to see where the camera points. Drawing them costs more CPU than the AprilTags alone, so it defaults to off. Has no effect unless withSimulatedVideoStreams(boolean) is on.
      Parameters:
      enabled - true to draw the field.
      Returns:
      This config, for chaining.
